views.markdown:
Spoof the stock Camera app: the viewfinder plays a looping video instead of the live camera, and saved photos/videos contain the same clip.

**Auto direction**: when the tweak sees a white arrow in a blue circle through the real camera (verification screens), it switches to the matching Up / Right / Left video — bundled clips of you, or your own URLs in **Settings → Scooby-Doo**. Front-camera mirroring is handled automatically.

**Settings → Scooby-Doo**: per-direction URLs + default video URL (downloaded once, cached on device) + **Enabled** toggle. Changes apply live, no respring.

**Rootless only** — palera1n / ElleKit.
